author: Haruko
name: VoiceChannelHandling
short: Temporary join-to-create voice channels with owner controls.
description: Creates and manages temporary Discord voice channels, including an in-channel dashboard for room owners.
install_msg: VoiceChannelHandling loaded. Use /setupvch to configure a creator voice channel.
end_user_data_statement: Stores per-guild temporary voice channel settings and mappings that include Discord channel, message, and user IDs.
